description: This file provides an enhanced version of the regcomp function, specifically for use within the Git project. It includes a conditional wrapper around the standard regcomp to ensure enhanced regular expression capabilities are enabled when extended patterns are requested.

methods.name: int git_regcomp(regex_t * preg,const char * pattern,int cflags)
methods.description: A wrapper around the standard regcomp function that ensures REG_ENHANCED flag is set when REG_EXTENDED is used.
